hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 9900X; CPU quota four cores; no GPU

int8_component.timing_scope: One warmed full generation per file/precision, excluding loading, feature construction and quantization; no quality or speed guarantee

model.decode: Native timestamps, minimum30s features, complete longer input, max_new_tokens440, no sampling/previous-text conditioning
model.role: Arabic evaluation transcription; shares Whisper ancestry with Turbo
model.reference_normalization: Raw transcription cache; scoring uses the prospective codec_text policy

packed_fp16_component.timing_scope: Earlier bound FP32 measurements versus one warmed packed-FP16 full generation per file; first-source FP32 sanity measured separately. Excludes loading/features/packing; no whole-CLI speed guarantee

model.decode: Native timestamps, minimum30s features, complete longer input, max_new_tokens440, no sampling/previous-text conditioning
model.role: Arabic evaluation transcription; shares Whisper ancestry with Turbo
model.reference_normalization: Raw transcription cache; scoring uses the prospective codec_text policy

packed_fp16_workflow.timing_scope: Whole local wrapper including model construction, original ASR/voice and fallback ASR/voice; no actual detector request or pacing
packed_fp16_workflow.meaning: Functional integration only; injected mock responses are not new endpoint observations or removal successes

comparison.scope: One complete spent-source local run per configuration, including construction/calibration; all detector replies explicitly mocked

fastconformer.artifact: Community ONNX int8 conversion, not official upstream numerical equivalence

sensevoice.license: FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement

recognizers.precision: Large linear weights packed FP16 with float32 inputs/outputs; Turbo/MMS/SenseVoice float32; pinned FastConformer INT8
recognizers.language_policy: Detect original language, force it for candidates; eleven supported utterance languages
recognizers.normalization: NFKC; Hindi/Tamil characters preserving combining vowel signs and viramas, punctuation/symbols removed, one-percent paired limit; Arabic vowel marks/tatweel removed; BasicTextNormalizer(False) elsewhere; Chinese OpenCC1.1.9 t2s characters; Japanese characters; Korean KsponSpeech spacing-normalized words; whitespace words otherwise
recognizers.candidate_guard_order: Secondary first; a failed secondary skips the primary, and accepted outputs still require both recognizers

summary.scope: Source-only precision comparisons against frozen original recognition, with no paired FP32 timing reference or removal observations

control_plan.scope: All nine Large-profile original recordings from the active cohort; source-only precision control, zero removal observations
control_plan.criteria: Keep every source; identical detected profile and normalized primary/secondary units required for parity; no retuning or case exclusion

limits: Component and whole-wrapper benchmarks reuse eight variants of three spent originals; the additional control reuses nine originals/eight voices from the active cohort. No new audio or removal observations.
Component measurements use forced known Hindi/Tamil language and one warmed full generation per file; loading/features/packing are excluded.
FP16 reuses the bound earlier FP32 measurements and separately reproduces its first-source reference; these are individual runs without statistical speed guarantees.
INT8 changed a primary guard decision and is not integrated. Packed FP16 remains experimental and outside the active frozen study.
Matching these fixtures does not prove unchanged recognition on arbitrary recordings or reliable removal.
The whole-wrapper comparison uses real speech/voice models and explicitly mocked detector replies, which are never counted as removal evidence.
